user.title: EnOcean gateway
user.description: Select the serial port of the EnOcean USB transceiver. Prefer the stable /dev/serial/by-id path.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EnOcean gateway
reconfigure.description: Select the new serial port of the EnOcean USB transceiver.

discovered_device.title: Discovered EnOcean device
discovered_device.description: Device {address} announced itself with profile {eep} (teach-in). Give it a name to add it. No teach-in response has been sent yet.

pair_or_manual.title: Sender ID
pair_or_manual.description: Device {address}. Pairing allocates the first free Base ID sender and answers the device's next teach-in with it. Choose manual entry for a device migrated from another controller: it keeps its historical sender ID.

menu_options.pair: Pair automatically (allocate a sender, answer the teach-in)

discovered_actuator.title: Actuator settings
discovered_actuator.description: Device {address}. The sender ID is the controller identity the actuator knows; the transceiver Base ID ({base_id}) is proposed and must stay within Base ID +127. Radio channel 0 is Channel 1 on the device.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot open the serial port or the transceiver did not answer. Check the path and make sure no other add-on or process owns the port.
error.invalid_sender: Enter the sender ID as 8 hexadecimal digits.
error.sender_out_of_range: The sender ID must be within the transceiver Base ID range (Base ID to Base ID +127).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one EnOcean gateway is supported.
abort.device_added: Device added to the EnOcean gateway.
abort.no_gateway: No EnOcean gateway is configured yet.
abort.not_connected: The EnOcean gateway is not connected.
abort.pair_timeout: No teach-in was received from the device in time. Trigger the teach-in on the device to get a new discovery card and try again.
abort.pair_no_free_sender: All 127 sender IDs of the transceiver Base ID range are in use; pairing cannot allocate one.
abort.pair_receive_only: This device is receive-only and needs no pairing. Add it from its discovery card or the radio inbox.

progress.pair_waiting: Press the teach-in (LRN) button on device {address} now. The gateway will answer its teach-in with the allocated sender ID.

inbox.title: Radio inbox
inbox.description: Senders heard recently that are not configured yet. A profile is only shown when the device declared it in a teach-in telegram; otherwise select the EEP yourself on the next screen.

add_manual.title: Add a device
add_manual.description: Enter the exact 8-digit radio address (leading zeroes matter) and the device EEP. A passive transmitter does not need to be re-paired.

actuator.title: Actuator settings
actuator.description: Device {address}. The sender ID is the controller identity the actuator already knows; it is proposed from the transceiver Base ID ({base_id}) and must stay within Base ID +127. Guided pairing from a discovery card can allocate one automatically instead. Radio channel 0 is Channel 1 on the device.

pair_name.title: Device paired
pair_name.description: Device {address} was paired with profile {eep} and sender ID {sender_id}. Give it a name to finish.

module_params.title: Actuator parameters
module_params.description: Pick the D2-01 actuator to configure.

module_params_form.title: Actuator parameters
module_params_form.description: {name} ({address}). One radio command writes ALL of these values to the module at once; there is no way to change just one. Check your module's manual for its factory values before submitting.

manage.title: Configured devices
manage.description: Pick a device to edit or remove.

edit_device.title: Edit device
edit_device.description: {name} ({address}, {eep}). The address and profile are the device's identity and cannot change; entities keep their IDs. Clearing the room removes the device from its room. For transmitting devices the sender ID must stay within the transceiver Base ID range ({base_id} to +127).

data_description.invert: For a cover wired backwards: open and close are swapped and the reported position is mirrored. Only covers can be inverted; the contact polarity is fixed by its profile.

settings.title: Gateway settings
settings.description: Query status on startup sends one status query to every configured switch and cover when the integration loads, so their state is confirmed within seconds after a restart (a toggle instead of the two on/off buttons). This transmits once per device per reload.

remove_confirm.title: Remove device
remove_confirm.description: Remove {name} ({address})? Its entities will be deleted. The physical device is not touched and no teach-out is sent.

import_devices.title: Import an inventory
import_devices.description:
Paste a JSON export document. Format: a top-level "version": 1 and a "devices" list; each device has "address" (8 hex digits), "eep", "name", and for transmitting devices "sender_id" and "channel". Optional: "area_id", and for D2-05-00 covers only "invert": true. The whole file is validated first; nothing is saved if any record is invalid.

{detail}

import_confirm.title: Import preview

export_devices.title: Export backup
export_devices.description:
Copy this document and store it safely. It contains recovery configuration and no secrets.

```
{export_json}
```

error.invalid_address: Enter exactly 8 hexadecimal digits, keeping leading zeroes.
error.invalid_sender: Enter the sender ID as 8 hexadecimal digits.
error.sender_out_of_range: The sender ID must be within the transceiver Base ID range (Base ID to Base ID +127).
error.import_invalid: The document was rejected; nothing was saved. See the details above.
error.not_eurid: This is a sender/base address, not a device address (device EURIDs end at FF7FFFFF).
error.not_acknowledged: The transceiver did not acknowledge the transmission. Nothing may have been written; check the module and try again.
error.cannot_send: The command could not be sent (transceiver disconnected or sender invalid). Check the gateway and try again.

abort.inbox_empty: No unconfigured senders have been heard yet.
abort.not_connected: The EnOcean gateway is not connected.
abort.pair_timeout: No teach-in was received in time. Start pairing again and press the teach-in button within the window.
abort.pair_no_free_sender: All 127 sender IDs of the transceiver Base ID range are in use; pairing cannot allocate one.
abort.pair_unsupported_eep: The device announced a profile this integration does not support. See the radio inbox for the declared EEP.
abort.pair_receive_only: This device is receive-only and needs no pairing. Add it from its discovery card or the radio inbox.
abort.params_sent: Parameters transmitted and acknowledged by the transceiver. Verify the module behaves as configured (local button, power-failure state).

progress.pair_waiting_any: Press the teach-in (LRN) button on the device now. The gateway will answer the first teach-in it hears with a freshly allocated sender ID.

serial_disconnected.title: EnOcean transceiver disconnected
serial_disconnected.description: The serial connection to {port} was lost. The integration keeps retrying automatically. Check that the USB transceiver is plugged in and that no other process has taken the port.

not_connected.message: The EnOcean gateway is not connected.

invalid_sender.message: Sender ID {sender_id} is outside the transceiver Base ID range; command not sent.

command_not_acknowledged.message: The transceiver did not acknowledge the command for {address}.
